# SupraCraft

Canonical organization hub: https://supracraft.github.io/
GitHub organization: https://github.com/SupraCraft
Public repository catalog: https://github.com/orgs/SupraCraft/repositories

SupraCraft maintains open-source systems and tooling across multiple project domains.
The organization hub provides orientation and discovery. Product-specific documentation,
downloads, compatibility information, and task flows remain on each product's own public site.

Machine-readable organization contract:
https://supracraft.github.io/organization.json

Machine-readable surface contract:
https://supracraft.github.io/surface.json

Navigation model:
- project-internal navigation stays in the same browsing context;
- navigation among SupraCraft-owned sites on supracraft.github.io stays in the same browsing context;
- external handoffs are explicitly marked and preserve the current SupraCraft page in a new browsing context.

Public discovery does not require private credentials.
